steps.name: keyframe:s3#1
steps.prompt: Medium-wide hero shot, eye level: a brown Louis Vuitton Monogram canvas steamer trunk with the gold LV Monogram flower and LV initial pattern, natural wooden slats, brass corners, brass lock and leather handles, standing open and upright with its lid raised, beside a brown Louis Vuitton Monogram canvas Keepall duffle bag with gold LV Monogram pattern and natural leather trim and rolled handles, centred on a polished stone floor of a bright modern glass-roofed train station, clear cream daylight streaming in, a sleek modern train blurred behind, 35mm lens, crisp present-day look. Style: Steam grey, slate blue and cream daylight; soft period haze in early scenes to crisp present-day light; 35mm and 24mm lenses, wide frames, gentle film grain; palette steam grey,slate blue,cream; camera lateral dolly, tracking along deck, slow push-in; pacing three 5s wide travelling takes, cross-era hard cuts. Continuity: Hook: in the first second the trunk is lowered onto a luggage cart. Trunk centred and readable in every scene from frame 1, Monogram pattern visible. Wide and moving shots (dolly, tracking), no macro. Palette steam grey, slate blue, cream daylight; period sepia-grey in s1-s2 warming to clear…. Single cinematic still frame, sharp focus on the subject, professional composition, photoreal. No captions, no garbled or fake text, no watermarks. The product must match the reference images exactly: same shape, colours, controls and markings.
